items.summary: Recommendation: Reject the proposed high-priority 0daynews repair because it targets failed queue work and lacks a demonstrated production outcome. Preserve the verified daily briefing workflow, do not retry unchanged outputs, and require CTO/Principal Engineer validation before any requeue. No safe new production candidate is defensible while 31 repair items remain open and measured outcomes are zero. Decision question: should the owner authorize a future bounded repair only after the failed reviewer evidence is corrected and the existing workflow remains protected?
